rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Berserker
rules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Blast
rules.description: If the target is hit all models within 4“ of it are also hit by this weapon.

rules.name: Brutal
rules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Berserker
rules.description: If this model has Berserker, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Berserker (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Berserker Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Berserker. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Brutal
rules.description: If this model has Brutal, the target always takes hits on unmodified hit results of 6 from Brutal (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Instinctive
rules.description: When this model is activated, if it is able to shoot/charge an enemy unit, then it must immediately attack the closest valid target and gets +1 to hit rolls for that attack.

rules.name: Melee Evasion
rules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

rules.name: Melee Evasion Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Melee Evasion. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Mend
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

rules.name: Pierce
rules.description: Ignores all positive Defense modifiers on the target, and when attacking units over half of this weapon's range away, this weapon gets AP(+1).

rules.name: Piercing Fighting Mark
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(+1) on their weapons in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Quick
rules.description: Moves +2" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Quick Shot
rules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

rules.name: Quick Shot Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Quick Shot. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Ravage
rules.description: Once per round, when it’s this model’s turn to strike in melee, roll X dice before attacking, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

rules.name: Re-Deployment
rules.description: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Surge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

spells.name: Berserker Frenzy
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets AP(+1) on their weapons in melee against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Clan Power
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Berserker once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Crush!
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 1 hit with Blast(3).

spells.name: Destroy!
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Pierce.

spells.name: Forge Protection
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets +1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Smash!
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Surge. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.
